remarks: Welcome to Apartment 203 at 118 Washington Street, ideally located in the heart of vibrant SoNo. This oversized studio apartment seamlessly blends charm, sophistication, and convenience. Featuring original hardwood floors throughout, the space is highlighted by a dramatic wall of floor-to-ceiling windows overlooking Washington Street, a charming wood-burning coal stove set against an exposed brick wall, soaring 9+ foot ceilings, central air conditioning, and an in-unit washer and dryer. The open-concept kitchen is thoughtfully designed with a breakfast bar, stainless steel appliances, quartz countertops, tiled backsplash, floating shelves, and a wine cooler - perfect for both everyday living and entertaining. Enjoy an unbeatable location just moments from SoNo's renowned shopping, dining, transportation, nightlife, and museums, offering the very best of urban coastal living right outside your door.
